g.text: How a smooth wave makes its own discontinuity

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #6b7280

g.text: inviscid Burgers, smooth initial data, no viscosity anywhere: the fast part of the wave catches up the slow part at a finite time, and the solution ceases to be differentiable — the reason conservation laws need weak solutions.
